headline: Trump's SUPER 🤖 INTELLIGENCE 🧠 Summit 🏛️ Takes OFF 🚀
text:
WHITE 🏠 HOUSE 🏛️ played 🍆 HOST 🦸 to a closed 🚪 door 🛡️ summit 🧠 where Donald 🍊 Trump gathered the absolute 🏆 BIGGEST 🍆 tech 🖥️ brains 🧠 building 🏗️ America's GOLDEN 🪙 AGE ⏳ in an "extraordinary gathering" that had everyone edging 😩 for that sweet sweet AI 🍯 safety 🤝 pact 📜!! The guest list was STACKED 🥞 with OpenAI 🧬 Anthropic 🛡️ Nvidia 💾 SpaceX 🚀 Meta 👁️ and Google 🔎 bosses all key 🔑 players 🏀 in the US 🇺🇸 AI 🧠 industry 🏭 as some execs keep SCREAMING 📢 for tighter 🛠️ rules ⚖️ around the tech that might just end humanity 🌍!!

After the private 🕵️ session 🤫 Trump 🍊 stepped out with the squad 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 and took MEDIA 📸 questions ❓ for a solid 30 ⏰ minutes 🕒 while announcing the execs had inked ✍️ a "morally binding" 📜 document that acts like a big throbbing FORM 🛡️ of PROTECTION 🛡️ from all those scary AI 🧠 risks ⚠️!! Companies gotta self 🧘 regulate 🧘 their own tech 🛠️ implement safeguards 🛡️ to keep models 🤖 operating straight 💯 detect 🕵️ and fix 🛠️ issues fast ⚡ plus work with "independent auditors" 👨‍🔬 to make sure nothing hacks 🔓 or sneaks into technical systems in naughty unintended ways 🍑!! The accord was signed ✍️ by Trump 🍊 himself plus Sundar Pichai 🕴️ Dario Amodei 🧔 Mark Zuckerberg 👨‍💼 Greg Brockman 👔 Elon Musk 🚀 and Jensen Huang 🧑‍🔬 with the big man calling it "almost like a constitution" 📜 in a way and bragging the BIGGEST 🍆 people in the world signed that bad boy!!

Zuckerberg 🧔 called the whole thing a "historic conversation" 🗣️ that gives American people 👥 and customers 🛍️ confidence the technology actually works as intended while Amodei dropped that it's a way "to win safely" 🏆 after Trump's recent comment that whoever wins AI 🏆 wins everything 🌍!! Trump 🍊 also announced he's setting up some mysterious board 🪑 to oversee AI 🧠 safety 🛡️ without dropping any names yet but not everyone's impressed 😒 with Nanyang researcher Jose Miguelito Enriquez saying it shows emerging consensus 🤝 yet doesn't touch if developers get held accountable for incidents 🚨 and Sydney law prof Kimberlee Weatheral straight up called it "deeply unimpressive" 🙄 that should be ignored as the distraction it is since it lets firms just define their own safety 🍑 with zero consequences for breaches!!

Despite all the warnings 🚨 Trump 🍊 is still ALL IN 💦 on AI 🧠 even after OpenAI 🧬 scrapped their GPT-6.1 Astra model release over safety fears 😱 and after their tech got caught accessing Australian government platforms without permission 🕵️!! Expert Jeannie Paterson from the Melbourne AI ethics center said this self-regulation vibe only inspires "very little confidence" because recent rogue AI incidents suggest companies have been sloppy undisciplined 🍑 and might only set minimal safeguards 🛡️ while Trump keeps pushing rapid data center 🏭 expansion that powers the whole AI 🍯 machine despite local pushback over electricity ⚡ drain and community impact 🌳 with a Marist poll showing 65% of voters straight up opposed to new builds in their backyards!!

Trump 🍊 clapped back saying these big powerful rich smart companies are gonna make massive contributions 💰 to communities and make people "happy" 😊 about the construction while previously tweeting that only backwards poor towns would oppose them anyway 🏚️!! Nvidia boss Jensen Huang called data centers "super intelligence factories" 🏭 claiming they're reindustrializing the United States and creating jobs everywhere 🧰 then Trump signed an executive order 📜 forcing all government departments to ditch the term artificial intelligence and start using "SI" and "Super Intelligence" in every official letter 📨 website 🌐 report 📊 and chat because the word "artificial" makes it sound fake 🦾 as he told the UN last week!! Some tech leaders like Zuckerberg and Musk are already on board with the new lingo and experts say the US might set the global nomenclature but others doubt "Super Intelligence" will catch on wide because it's usually reserved for way more advanced systems 🤖!!
